citation: Lauf and Adragna, Journal of General Physiology 108 (1996), 341–350
preparation: Low-potassium sheep red cells with intracellular pH and volume clamped. Potassium efflux and rubidium influx were measured separately. Chloride-minus-nitrate subtraction isolated the chloride-dependent component.
observable: Slope of normalized extracellular rubidium at zero net flux (external Rb / internal K) against internal Cl / external Cl. Both coordinates are dimensionless.
locator: Figures 5–7 determine reversal from a fitted zero of net flux. Figure 8 compares normalized reversal with the chloride ratio.
uncertainty: No uncertainty for either fitted slope was reported. The correlations describe the fits. Rubidium substitutes for external potassium in the comparison.
model_prediction: Unit slope follows from equal concentration products for a single 1:1 carrier when effective activities follow the measured concentrations. No capacity or volume parameter is fitted.
